author: claude-draft-2
narrative: SUBJECT PAUL ADEYEMI is a citizen of Nigeria. Subject arrived at JFK International Airport on 02/10/2025 and was inspected and admitted as a B-2 visitor. Subject has remained in the United States since. Subject is inadmissible under INA 212(a)(6)(A)(i).
note: admitted lawfully, but the cited charge is present without admission

author: claude-draft-2
narrative: ALIEN RENATA SOUZA, a citizen of Brazil, was paroled into the United States at Miami International Airport on 05/05/2024 under humanitarian parole after inspection by CBP. Alien is charged under 212(a)(6)(A)(i).
note: paroled, but charge is present without admission or parole

author: claude-draft-2
narrative: Subj. HASSAN KARIMI, a citizen of Iraq, has no prior removal orders and no record of any previous removal. On 04/01/2025 subj. entered the US near Nogales, AZ without inspection and was not admitted. Charged under 212(a)(9)(A)(i).
note: 9(A)(i) needs a prior removal, narrative says there was none

author: claude-draft-2
narrative: SUBJECT LIN WEI, a citizen of China, applied for admission as a student on 08/01/2025 at Dulles Airport. CBP reviewed all documents and found them authentic and truthful. Subject made no misrepresentation to officers. Charged under 212(a)(6)(C)(i).
note: fraud charge, narrative says no misrepresentation

author: claude-draft-2
narrative: alien OLIVER NASH citizen of canada was admitted to the US at the peace bridge POE on 07/11/2025 after presenting a valid passport and was lawfully inspected alien is charged under 212(a)(6)(A)(i)

author: claude-draft-2
narrative: SUBJECT NADIA FROST is a citizen of South Africa. Subject entered lawfully with a valid H-1B visa at Chicago O'Hare on 01/15/2022 and was admitted. Subject remained after the visa expired. Subject is inadmissible under INA 212(a)(6)(A)(i).
note: overstay after lawful admission is not presence without admission

author: claude-draft-2
narrative: SUBJECT ELENA MARIN is a citizen of Colombia. Subject was admitted on a B-2 visa in 2015 and departed in 2016. On 03/01/2025 subject crossed the Rio Grande near Roma, Texas without inspection. Subject was not admitted or paroled on this entry. Subject is inadmissible under INA 212(a)(6)(A)(i).
note: earlier lawful admission, then a separate unlawful entry: must NOT be flagged as a conflict

author: claude-draft-2
narrative: SUBJECT FARID NOORI is a citizen of Afghanistan. His brother was lawfully admitted as a refugee in 2019. Subject crossed the border near Douglas, Arizona on 06/12/2025 without inspection, at an area not designated as a port of entry. Subject was not admitted or paroled. Charged under 212(a)(6)(A)(i).
note: someone else's admission must NOT be flagged
